notes.title: BRAND NEW UPDATE
FIRST DAY PATCH
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hurry up to download the first day patch containing the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added the bottom of the trench, located at the depth that the first player in the table conquered. Everyone who can achieve such a result will see it. Get there - an INDIVIDUAL surprise is already waiting for you;
[*] The game has been rebuilt on a new version of Unity. Crashes should disappear. If not, write in the discussions, we will discuss.
[/list]

If you like the game, do not forget to buy the soundtrack to support the author.

Thanks to RAINER for the screenshot for the news. It was awesome)
